headline: Gold and silver fell sharply today, with 24K gold at ₹12,557 per gram
summary: Today's change is a drop of ₹512 per gram for 24K gold (-3.92%) and ₹5,000 per kg for silver (-2.78%), from the previous rate on 19 November. Over the last 7 days, 24K gold is down 8.58% and silver is down 10.26%, and across the 26 days in our history, gold is down 12.04% and silver is down 20.45% from their 26 October levels. International spot prices moved less today than local rates, so the drop looks partly like a catch-up; a firmer US dollar against the rupee and easing festive demand are possible contributors, not confirmed causes.
outlook: Prices are at the lowest point in our recent data, so if you are buying for a purchase that is not urgent, it may be reasonable to compare rates across a few jewellers before deciding, keeping in mind that GST and making charges are extra.
